epics.title: Core Knowledge Base & UI Platform
epics.jtbd: When an educational center participant searches for regulatory and methodological documents, I want to find the exact current version and templates instantly through a structured, strictly Russian interface, so that I can prepare for classes and attestations without using outdated information.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce document search and retrieval time for end users from 10 minutes to under 2 seconds
epics.tocConstraintRef: Manual document search and verification process bottleneck
requirements: R1: The UI must be strictly in Russian, with no foreign languages in any interface elements or placeholders.
R2: The UI must implement the Lexicon Flux design system (dark blue #1A365D, Inter/JetBrains fonts, 0.25rem corners, card-based layout).
R3: The system must enforce role-based access control for Admins, Content Managers, Teachers, and Students.
R4: The system must support document uploads (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, etc.), versioning, and archiving of outdated items.
R5: The system must provide full-text search with support for synonyms (e.g., ФБУН), typos, and metadata filtering.
R6: Documents must support metadata tagging including Type, Year, Program, and Status.
R7: Users must be able to leave comments and submit requests for document updates.

slices.title: Document architecture spike
slices.jtbd: When implementing the storage layer for this epic, I want to define the exact database and search engine architecture, so that the knowledge base has a scalable foundation.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a need for full-text search with synonyms,
When evaluating architectures,
Then an ADR is produced selecting the storage engine.
Given the chosen engine,
When analyzing schema impacts,
Then a documented index structure is provided.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce architectural uncertainty regarding search latency to 0

slices.title: Database schema for documents and roles
slices.jtbd: When implementing the persistence layer for this epic, I want to create schemas for documents, versions, metadata, and roles, so that structured data can be reliably stored and queried.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the need to store documents,
When the database migration is executed,
Then tables for documents and versions are created.
Given the requirement for metadata,
When inserting a document record,
Then fields for Type, Year, and Status are strictly typed.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Relational schema design for document metadata bottleneck
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% schema compliance for document versioning and metadata

slices.title: API contract for documents and search
slices.jtbd: When implementing API integration for this epic, I want to define the OpenAPI spec for document CRUD and search endpoints, so that backend and frontend can develop in parallel.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a frontend building the knowledge base,
When reading the OpenAPI spec,
Then endpoints for document search and upload are fully defined.
Given the RBAC requirements,
When viewing the endpoints,
Then security schemes and role requirements are documented.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% endpoint specification coverage for document CRUD and search

slices.title: Backend API for document management
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to build the API for document uploading, versioning, and RBAC enforcement, so that content can be safely managed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Content Manager uploading a file,
When the API receives the request,
Then a new document version is created and stored.
Given a Student requesting document deletion,
When the API receives the request,
Then a 403 Forbidden is returned.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce document upload and version processing error rate to under 0.1%

slices.title: Backend API for full-text search
slices.jtbd: When implementing search functionality for this epic, I want to build the full-text search endpoint with synonym support, so that users can find materials efficiently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user querying the search endpoint,
When they use a known synonym like ФБУН,
Then documents containing the expanded terms are returned.
Given an invalid search term with a typo,
When the search runs,
Then fuzzy matching returns the closest documents.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase search query precision and recall to over 95%

slices.title: Frontend UI implementation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend for this epic, I want to build the knowledge base interface using Lexicon Flux in strict Russian, so that users have a native and cohesive experience.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user opens the knowledge base,
When the UI renders,
Then all text, labels, and placeholders are strictly in Russian.
Given the Lexicon Flux design system,
When displaying a document card,
Then it uses #1A365D color, Inter font, and 0.25rem rounded corners.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero non-Russian language elements and 100% Lexicon Flux compliance in UI

slices.title: QA tests for core platform
slices.jtbd: When verifying the implementation for this epic, I want to run E2E and API tests on document flows and search, so that no regressions enter production.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the knowledge base API is deployed,
When running E2E tests,
Then document upload, versioning, and search workflows pass successfully.
Given the RBAC rules,
When running security tests with a student token,
Then unauthorized modification endpoints return 403.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test coverage for document lifecycle, search API, and RBAC rules

epics.title: LMS and Messenger Integrations
epics.jtbd: When the knowledge base content is updated or accessed, I want it to sync with existing LMS systems and notify users via messengers, so that the learning ecosystem remains unified and users are instantly informed of critical changes.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of users reading updated documents within 24 hours from baseline to >90%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Isolated platforms and manual notification bottleneck
requirements: R1: The system must synchronize user authorization and roles with the ЭИОС platform.
R2: The system must index and support searching of metadata for materials hosted on SDO.crie.ru and Teachbase.
R3: The system must automatically send notifications to Telegram and Max messengers when documents are updated.
R4: The system must collect analytics on views, downloads, and search queries, and provide exports for ЭИОС.

epics.title: Financial & HR Module
epics.jtbd: When managing educational center operations, I want a specialized structured section for financial, budget, and load distribution documents, so that administration and faculty can access sensitive operational templates with strict access control.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents to financial documents to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: Manual HR and financial document distribution bottleneck
requirements: R1: Create a specialized financial and HR document structure (Budget, Load, Stipends, Reports) within the knowledge base.
R2: Enforce strict access boundaries: Economists/Admins have full access, Teachers see methodologies and their own load, Students only see stipend regulations.
R3: Financial and HR documents must include specific metadata such as Budget cycle, load type, and department tags.

slices.title: Data schema for financial metadata
slices.jtbd: When implementing the persistence for this epic, I want to add schema tags for financial metadata and HR roles, so that strict access can be modeled in the database.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given financial documents require strict isolation,
When the migration runs,
Then schema tags for Budget and Load are created.
Given the HR module,
When defining roles,
Then Economist and HR roles are seeded.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% accurate enforcement mapping of HR/Finance schema tags

slices.title: API contract for financial documents
slices.jtbd: When implementing API boundaries for this epic, I want to specify the endpoints for HR and financial document retrieval, so that frontend components can correctly query scoped data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the frontend needs financial data,
When reviewing the OpenAPI spec,
Then restricted endpoints for stipends and load are defined.
Given the specialized metadata,
When checking schemas,
Then budget cycle fields are documented.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% specification for restricted financial API endpoints

slices.title: Backend API for financial documents
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to build the logic for HR document CRUD and strict role enforcement, so that sensitive financial data is protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an Economist requests the budget report,
When the API is called,
Then the full document is returned.
Given a Teacher requests the budget report,

slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0% unauthorized access via API to protected HR/Finance data

slices.acceptanceCriteria:

slices.title: QA tests for financial access control
